tasks.title: Decouple Approve button from comments and display approvalState.output
tasks.description: In IssueDetailPage.tsx: (1) Add `reviewOutput` computed value that reads `selfReviewNotes` or `reviewReport` from `approvalState.output`, falling back to last comment body. (2) Change Approve button condition from `{isApprovalGate && lastAgentComment && ...}` to `{isApprovalGate && ...}`. (3) Split the approval panel into two independent blocks: report area (`{isApprovalGate && reviewOutput && ...}`) and approve button (`{isApprovalGate && ...}`). (4) Remove `lastAgentComment` variable, inline its fallback logic into `reviewOutput`. (5) Change report area title from 'Latest agent output' to 'Review Report'.
acceptanceCriteria: Approve button displays when `isApprovalGate` is true regardless of comments existence
Report area shows `selfReviewNotes` from approvalState.output when present (Plan stage)
Report area shows `reviewReport` from approvalState.output when present (Review stage)
Report area falls back to last comment body when approvalState.output is empty
Report area is hidden when both approvalState.output and comments are empty, but Approve button still shows
Send Message block remains unchanged (already only depends on isApprovalGate)
Typecheck passes: cd packages/cli/web && npx tsc --noEmit
tasks.notes: Backend output structure: Plan stage = { stage, issueNumber, selfReviewNotes }, Review stage = { stage, issueNumber, reviewReport }. Handle empty object {} (truthy but no content) by checking extracted string values.
